value.rationale: The canonical cubic symmetric Desargues graph offers a natural laboratory for shortest-path communication with selected interior vertices forbidden. The complete nonpure visibility complex (maximal sizes 6,7,8), the exact two orbit types of optima, and the sharp split between two mobile Petersen-line sectors and 120 jump-isolated optima (all slide-frozen) constitute a motivated structural classification of natural configurations and mobility barriers. This is not a routine normalization, a single unmotivated scalar, or a subsumed deduction from existing general visibility formulas.
